verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents autonomous agents that edit code and run commands across the editor, terminal and browser, plus Git worktree support. Nothing in the evidence shows it ingesting a tracked issue or opening a pull request. MCP, hooks and the SDK are only developer building blocks that could be used to construct such a flow, so they earn no credit toward this end-to-end issue-to-PR story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
